lines.english: "Izumi seems to be the surname of Senou's mother."
"Senou…"
"Ah, I imagine you're probably not very familiar with this. In other words, Senou was the name Izumi used when she was still in high school."
"I've heard that she's been living with her mother's side of the family after her parents divorced around the time she graduated from high school."
"Her home is in… Arikawa?"
"I see, so you've heard about that already. …This is information I got from an underclassman who used to be in the Theater Club. Well, I used to go out with her."
I still can't really understand what Takeya's trying to tell me.
"Well, here's the important thing, though… That woman already knew about you since high school."
I still can't wrap my head around the reality of Takeya's recollecting and complaining about Chiaki as if he were actually familiar with her.
"And not only you. She even knew about Setsuna-chan and Touma. …She even knew about your relationship with Setsuna-chan to a certain degree."
"Why would…"
"I told her about this three years ago. She just wouldn't stop asking me about you."
"That woman, how should I put it, uh… She became a fan of the group after the school festival."
"I don't understand what you mean by that…"
Moreover…
Has Takeya ever referred to a girl as "that woman" in front of me up until today?
"How should I say this, it's kind of hard to explain. It's just that I overlooked the fact… that she could actually make it into Houjou University."
I don't think he… really dislikes her or anything, but more so finds someone like her difficult to deal with, or perhaps he's fearful of her.
"Her grades were always rock bottom, and she skipped class all the time too, so I felt at ease with the assumption that there was no way she could get a recommendation to enroll here."
Takeya's never had this kind of attitude toward a girl before, and it's making me feel increasingly anxious.
Chiaki…
What in the world are you?
"Well… this is her base of operations after she came to university."
Takeya took me somewhere that was far deeper into the sports grounds; away from the main school building by about a highway's width, to a very isolated corner past even all the other club buildings.
There's a small and aged auditorium hall.
"Watos… Troupe?"
"Among our theater circles, they're one of the most popular troupes. …Or at least that's what I heard, I'm not quite sure about the details either."
The plate in front of the door listing the group who's using the facility for today is a group I'm not exactly familiar with.

"The number of members they have is much less than any other club's, but they have the combination of their starring member plus president, along with their scripter plus leading actress… or so it seems."
"Scripter and leading actress…"
I heard about that yesterday.
In the first segment of that DVD, during the credits section of that amazing play that took place three years ago.
"Seems like they're practicing. How about it, Haruki? Wanna have a look?"
"Eh…"
With the way things are now, all I can do is let Takeya drag me as I enter the premises.
I approach the truth without any semblance of caution exactly because I'm unable to process my own thoughts.
"Even though I'm the one who brought you here, you're the one who has to decide if you want to see it for yourself."
"Ta-Takeya, you… So you've already gone so deep into this…"
But, from this point…
You can't really propose a situation where it's as if I'm about to open Pandora's box and expect me to carelessly open it without any semblance of wariness.
"I don't even know what to do anymore. I never would've thought that you'd end up getting involved with that woman…"
"You've been calling her 'that woman' since a while ago… What's your problem with Chiaki? Did something happen between you two in the past?"
"Of course not. It's just that she's someone I simply can't understand."
"I have no clue what you mean by that!"
"That's why I told you to confirm it for yourself!"
What's going on here…?
Takeya has been telling me some very ambiguous things starting with the voicemail he left me last night.
Takeya's told me that he knows about Chiaki.
And he knew about her since we were still in high school… In other words, we've been in the same school for the past six years.

Back then, Chiaki's family name was Senou, she was the club president of our theater club, which was at national competition level. During the school festival three years ago, she played all four sisters in the play perfectly…
As expected, I still don't know what he's trying to say. What exactly am I supposed to do…?
"I won't do this anymore!"
"Ooh!?"
That mysterious door suddenly slammed open from the inside.
"I'm not doing this, I won't do this anymore! Just look for some substitute on your own!"
It was a young man who forced the door of the hall open, his angry words equally forceful.
"Wait, wait, wait a moment. Please calm down for a bit, okay?"
"How can I be calm about this! She didn't have to go that far with saying all that, now, did she!? Is that how you're supposed to treat your colleagues?"
"Like I said, calm down… Didn't you know full well about how the princess never compromises on anything?"
"You're to blame for this too, President! That woman's become so brazen because of you…"
"…That couldn't be helped. The princess is the reason why the Watos Troupe exists."
"If only you could pull yourself together a bit more…"
"What can I accomplish on my own? …While I'm at it, who else apart from her has the ability to accomplish anything?"
"…You may go home for today. I'll contact you again tonight."
"Ah…"
That mess I just witnessed ended slightly more than ten seconds after it started.
"…Goodness me. Did you guys see that embarrassing scene? …Are you guys trying to join the team?"
"Ah, no, we're just here to observe a little… What was that, though?"
"Nothing much, just some quarrel between club members. Well, that just means everyone's serious about it. …Don't worry about it, it's very common."
"Uh-huh…"
But I didn't pay much attention to the man who just left, nor did I listen to Takeya's conversation.
"If you're here to observe… you're here to see her, huh? Senouchi Akira, I mean."
"Senouchi… Akira?"
"Oh? You're not? I was pretty sure you were here to see our best actress."
"Senou. Chiaki. Ra…?"
"Well, whatever, we welcome everyone here. We're just practicing reading the script for today, it's probably not that interesting. Want to come in and have a look?"
"Ah, it's okay… we're fine here. Don't worry about it."
It's just that, through the shadow of that opened door, I focused all five of my senses, trying to perceive what's inside the hall.
"Alright, let's continue then. …Who's going to take Yoshida's place? Want me to do it?"
"No need. That level of acting might as well not exist."

I could easily recognize that the voice that came out from the hall belonged to her from how sharp it was in terms of vocal quality and what she was saying, even without having to concentrate to do so.
"Please don't be so harsh when he's still trying to memorize his lines…"
"No, that person doesn't understand 'him' at all. He didn't use any emotion. …I might as well solo this play as well."
"Princess…"
Instead of the voice that's always been by my side, it feels more like the voice from the DVD that recorded the play from three years ago.
"'He' is actually an inherently sensitive person. But you could never tell that from his usual behavior. He'll only let it slip when he takes a moment to catch his breath."
But I'm certain.
The person who stood on the center of the stage, her presence alone is enough to apply pressure to every other member…
It's the person who's always sleepy, always looking at me with a listless smile, and also the person who gently accepted me…
"So it's these complicated personality traits again… Can't we make it a bit simpler?"
"If we do that, then it won't be 'him' anymore. This entire script would then be meaningless."
"Haah…"
"That person won't do. That's not like 'him' at all. The real 'him' is much cuter than that!"
"Ah～ that 'him' the princess is talking about can be dealt with later. So let's just think about what to do for now."
"Like I said, let's just practice my part."
"Guess we can't help it. We'll discuss the issue of the protagonist with everyone tomorrow. Alright～ let's continue."
I couldn't understand it at all. No matter how hard I think about it, I can't come to a conclusion.
"Well then, let's start from the beginning of page fourteen."
The inescapable maze of thoughts forming in my head are gradually driving my heart further into a corner.
And then…
I can hear a singing voice that threatens to crush my heart from the auditorium.
"Could…"
"Could you be… the guitarist?"
The girl who's singing a cappella.
She finally hears the noise, turns around, and starts asking questions of the person standing there.
"The guitarist?" and…
"I see, so you are the ones playing… White Album."
"It might be an old song… but I really like it. …Don't you think so as well?"
"Nice to meet you, Guitar-san. I am…"
The details are slightly different.
That's not the first time we met each other. She already knew me back then.
That's why she didn't call me Guitar-san, she called me Mr. Executive Committee Member's helper back then.
Even so, but, still…
This is without a doubt an old, irreplaceable scar of mine.
…I told her about this when I was sleeping with her, it's the meeting between Setsuna and me.
"Well, I'll return the key. You can go home first."
"Make sure you return it, okay? Don't be like last year and practice on your own until morning again, okay?"
"It'll be fine. The script is not finished yet. I'll sleep properly back in the club room."
"Can you really call that properly…?"
"See you, President."
"Ah, and also… about Yoshida."
"Doesn't matter. He's useless anyway."
"Don't say it like that… We'll run out of male members at this rate."
"Isn't that because you're terrible at picking people, President? Why don't you find someone more useful?"
"…I'll work on that. In any case, please give him another chance."
"That's so annoying… Well, we'll talk about that tomorrow. Good work."
"Yeah… thanks for your great work."
The moment she noticed me at such an unexpected hour and such an unexpected place, Chiaki was momentarily at a loss for words, standing there with a plain expression.
Izumi Chiaki appeared before me again, this time looking like someone I've never seen before.
"Chiaki…"
At an unexpected hour and unexpected place, hearing my voice, Chiaki's body trembled for a moment.
Among the expressions that I've seen from her up until now, just exactly how much do they amount to in the total percentage of expressions she can make?
"Oh…"
Blood slightly returned to Chiaki's face that looked pale just a moment ago.
The expressionless face Chiaki had started to show both happy and sad emotions at the same time.
That was the moment where the stage actress that I was unfamiliar with became the Izumi Chiaki that I know.
"Oh dear…!"
Chiaki closed the few meters of distance between us and flew straight to my chest in an instant.
The softness of her body and the smell of her sweat, both of which I'm all too familiar with, stimulates me almost immediately.
"Even though I decided for us not to see each other for a while… I thought that it would be best for both of us."
Breaths spout out with her earnest, coquettish voice.
It was extremely easy for me to immediately think how this is undoubtedly Chiaki, despite the fact that she's different from what I'm used to.
"Chi-Chiaki, hey…"
…If it wasn't for what I've seen in the last hour, this should still be "the usual Chiaki."
"See, what I had in mind was that you'd be able to return to your normal self with a little more time, Haruki, and after that we'd pick up from where we left off."
"Why didn't you contact me!?"
"Are you just showing me pity? Or are you simply toying with me?"
"Why did you go out of your way to find me? Why did you chase after me?"
That's what I planned to say to her, but she completely sealed everything I wanted to say.
"I-I… If you're like this, I won't be able to stop myself any longer… That's not how I'm supposed to be."
"A-Ah…"
The way she's seeing right through me is very painful.
If you just hit me with words like this… If you just let out how you feel, saying you couldn't hold your feelings in any longer like this…
Don't tell me that what I just saw was simply an illusion, that it was actually you putting on a one-man-show again…
"Haruki… I'm back. I'm yours…"
"…Yo, Senou."
Just like that, the faint ray of hope instantly disappeared the moment Chiaki lightly clicked her tongue.
"Well, it's Izumi now, right? You should show up to some of your class reunions. We do happen to be close by, after all."
"…Long time no see, Iizuka-kun."
I could feel no warmth from the words of the person whose breaths are permeating across my chest.
"Didn't we see each other one time last year? In front of Haruki's apartment, I mean."
"I thought you didn't notice it～ I thought you forgot my appearance a long time ago."
"Unfortunately, I can never forget the appearance of a beauty for the rest of my life."
"…Well, much obliged. That's quite the pointless ability you have there, though."
Chiaki's face is still buried in my chest.
From such a spectacle, a bystander would assume that she's a spoiled girlfriend who's throwing a tantrum on the brink of tears after a long-awaited reunion with her lover.
But…
"Haruki… you should confirm it again."
"This person… Senou Chiaki is… an alien that's beyond the comprehension of humans like us."
I'm suddenly incapable of understanding the woman in my arms whom I'm supposed to understand very well whatsoever, as if I've immediately accepted Takeya's words.
"You know, Iizuka-kun…"
"Don't ever believe anything she says, Haruki! It's all just an act from beginning to end! …And she's a genius at that."
"You've been running your mouth off for a while now, but I want you to correct something."
"What is it?"
"I'm Senouchi Akira here. Not Senou Chiaki or Izumi Chiaki. Got it?"
Chiaki invited me into the auditorium. It's a dark place with a single light to brighten things up.
A single spotlight focused on the stage.
The footsteps on the wooden stage resound across the space where no one else is present other than us.
Then she stopped and stood there, at the one spot the spotlight focused on, at the center of the stage.
"Seems like you've finally seen it. My true self… I've prayed many times that you would never discover this."
"Eh…"
"…Yuutsuru. It won first place in a competition when I was still in middle school."
The one staring down at me is no longer the Izumi Chiaki I know.
"Nice to meet you, Kitahara Haruki-kun. I'm Senouchi Akira from the Watos Troupe. …Or you could say, the actress who played Izumi Chiaki, I guess?"
The crane that was saved that day took the form of a human girl.
"It's cold, isn't it? There's no air conditioner, so it's boiling hot during summer and freezing cold during winter."
Chiaki said that while her breath was visible in the cold.
"The venue is rather small, so it can't really fit that many people, and it means that regular performances have guests lining up to the exterior."
Although this place isn't that big, the cold air in here still pierces through my skin.
"Even so, I still like this place a lot. Because this is my home turf."
In the freezing air, Chiaki's smiling.
"Speaking of which, my home turf during high school was the stage in the gym."
Without a doubt, she knows how I feel right now, and she's still showing the usual smile she always had with me.
"Along with you, Haruki, and Ogiso-san, and Touma-san… it's the same place where you guys share your memory."
"Ah…"
"You were very cute, you know that, Haruki? When you played the guitar back then."
"Chiaki…"
"…Are you mad?"
This woman… she knew everything about us.
"I was prepared to just disappear and fade away for good. If that happened, it'd be good for both you and me… Ogiso-san would also achieve happiness."
The things I said. The things I didn't say… The things I… couldn't say.
"But Iizuka-kun did something unnecessary… Well, Mizusawa-san was probably the one behind it, actually."
"You… You…!"
"Maybe I should correct the 'nice to meet you' bit… Long time no see, Kitahara-kun. Do you remember me? Senou Chiaki from Class G. …Well, you probably don't, right?"
"Ah, ah… ah-aahhh!"
It's like she was nonchalantly greeting me at an alumni reunion…
Izumi Chiaki… Senou Chiaki… Senouchi Akira… she's wearing a sweet smile devoid of any malicious intent on her face.
"Cheer up, Haruki… okay?"
Chiaki's attempting to encourage me under the persona of Izumi Chiaki as I collapse to my knees on the stage.
"I can't question the fact that I'm at fault for deceiving you, but you also have yourself to blame for not realizing it as well, you know?"
In this situation so treacherous it's sending chills up my spine, Chiaki's words, demeanor and breaths envelop me in warmth as usual.
"After all, Haruki, you and I pretty much never had any sort of connection back in high school."
Is it because of her great acting that I felt so taken by her I couldn't help myself? Or is it because of another reason…

"You commute by train, Haruki, while I commute by bike. You take work at school seriously, while I skip classes all the time. You do your best at studying, while I do my best at after-school activities."
Even so, we've been in the same school for three years. We definitely should have run into each other somewhere.

"The class representative who always scored in the top ten, and the underperforming student who always scored in the bottom ten. The president of the Go-Home club and substitute member of the Light Music Club, and the one-man army of a president of the Theater Club."
My only impression of her was that Senou-san's grades are almost as bad as Touma's.
"Be it our hobbies or grades, they're all completely different… That's why there was no way we would have met each other."
Is it because I was too dull to realize it, or is it because Chiaki is too good at hiding it…
"If that's the case, why do you have to hide it…?"
"Earlier, didn't you already witness it?"
She doesn't think she's done anything wrong. She's not apologizing either.
She's not even averting her gaze from me.
"It's because Haruki, you… changed over to the Literature Department. You came back to my side…"
"And so the plan that I concocted three years ago, yet one I never got to accomplish, started progressing."
"…A new face, huh?"
"So you changed your department? What? So would that make you a first-year here?"
"I see… Hey, if that's the case, we've gotta throw a welcome party! Don't worry about it. We're fellow classmates starting today, right?"
"…So come on, go on and buy us some beer, would you, new guy?"
During the first class of my specialized course's lecture, she sat next to me…
Back then, Chiaki already knew about me.
And she knew me so well that she treated me with the familiarity she would have with a character she included in the plot of a drama she wrote herself.
That's why Chiaki's been treating me as a character in her play since then.
"Haruki… Ever since three years ago, I've been a huge fan of yours, of the unit consisting of Ogiso Setsuna, Touma Kazusa, and you…"
"Compared to your stage play… our performance was…"
It was amateurish and extremely rushed…
The karaoke master, the genius pianist, and the amateur guitarist who was only good at studying, our personalities didn't match at all either.
"But the result was amazing. It was much more popular than our plays."
"That's… because we had Setsuna."
"That's what everyone said… it's all because they had Ogiso Setsuna as the singer…"
"But after it was over, some people started saying that Touma Kazusa's performance was really amazing."
I think that's true as well.
That stage could be taken by just having Setsuna and Kazusa's performance, that alone was more than enough to mesmerize the entire audience.
My presence had no impact at all…
"But it's not only that. There was also a certain something in that performance."
But Chiaki denied something that even I, who was part of that stage, thought was the truth.
"When I heard the song you guys created, I felt a certain sadness in it, as if there was something that I couldn't forget or simply let go…"
"It's natural that you'd feel sad because our performance came directly after yours ended, right..?"
"That's not it. I'm very confident in controlling my emotions. …Haruki, didn't you already experience it?"
While we were talking, while we were kissing, while we were holding each other, while we were living together…
She would always freely control her emotions and act in ways that tended to my own emotions with perfection.
I was completely unaware of that.
"That's why I focused everything I had on observing every detail on the stage. From finger movements, to eye expression, as well as your 'performance.'"
"Why would you…"
"It was quite interesting when I realized it…"
"What was so interesting about it…?"
"Well, the three of you just ignored the audience and were just flirting with each other up there."
"What's that supposed to mean…?"
"Ogiso-san and Touma-san were both trying their very best to get your attention. Both of them were competing with each other to perform for your sake."
"What… are you saying?"
"The love-triangle relationship you guys were having could easily be seen during that performance, you know?"
"That's a lie… That… How could that…"
"Can you really say that it's a lie? From that day until the day of graduation, what happened between the three of you, I wonder?"
"After three years, I finally figured out the truth. That atmosphere was created by you, Haruki."
Why did I say it…? Why did I tell someone so easily…?

"Despite the fact that your performance was rather awkward, it was as fascinating as it was because the three of you came together… As well as the fact that you've managed to make both of them feel attracted to you."
I've already sworn not to think about what happened on that day ever again.
"And so, my interest toward you spiked. You three became very interesting 'material' to me."
"The title was already set… Obviously, it'd be Todokanai Koi."
"Sung by Ogiso Setsuna… Yet it's a song that's written based on Haruki's feelings toward Touma Kazusa."
"You may not notice it, Haruki, but you're quite cruel sometimes, you know. What kind of emotions do you think Ogiso-san felt when she sang this song?"
To what extent…? Just how much…?
Just how deeply did the actress Senouchi Akira infiltrate my heart under the name of Izumi Chiaki?
"It isn't exactly flashy with some big event happening, a completely simple psychological tale. I imagine the guests won't exactly give the most favorable reception…"
She used her own body in exchange for the setting of this story, to find more details in order to make this story more complete.
"But I want to reenact it again no matter what. I'm a crazy fan of that day, you know?"
"Is that why… you got close to me? For something so silly… you slept with me?"
"It's not 'silly' at all to me… In my opinion, it's the exact opposite."
"You…"
"Just like how you think sleeping with a woman is not 'silly,' Haruki."
Ahh…
In other words, in Chiaki's eyes, sleeping with me was just something silly…
She can let out the fact that I didn't think it was silly at all with a composed expression on her face.
"The way I am now, I can reenact the role of both Ogiso Setsuna and Touma Kazusa. …It's all thanks to you, Haruki."
"You told me the true story behind you three. You taught me how to act like the two heroines. …And you've even taught me what it means to be a 'woman.'"
"You're the best director there is. Going through all that for you was definitely not a waste."
"After all… winning you over was definitely not easy, you know?"
"In terms of being a 'cute girl,' I couldn't beat Ogiso Setsuna. In terms of being a 'cool woman,' I couldn't beat Touma Kazusa."
"And when I started to wonder what it was that I needed to do, my answer was to become that 'Chiaki-chan.'"
"If you were running from the woman that was Ogiso Setsuna, Haruki, you probably needed 'a woman who doesn't behave like a woman' in order to feel safe."
"I couldn't show it normally, but I had to become feminine and accept you when you needed it. …It was quite a difficult role to play… How did I do?"
"Ha… haha…"
I can't say anything. I can only let out a dry laugh.
No, I couldn't even laugh properly; even this laughing sound was something I forced out of my throat so that the person right next to me could barely hear it.
"The secret to not letting others know that I'm acting… is to add a very small amount of my actual feelings into it."
She's someone from my seminars who's at times more than a friend, but not quite a girlfriend. Other times, she's a mysterious close friend who does things mindlessly.
"For example, about my parents…"
Other times, she takes the role of a lover who'll gently accept everything about me.
"Much like you, Haruki, my parents were divorced and I was taken in by my mother's side… It was nice for the two of us to have something in common, as negative as it is."
But the truth is…
Just like the time she researched the northern folktales, she approached men because she was studying themーshe's an actress to the core.
"Since there's an undeniable truth there, Haruki, you would never be able to see through that lie."
I did think about the possibility of being tricked.
But given the way she worried about me, I'm sure she did take my feelings into consideration.
But who could have ever imagined that… all this was merely an act? To think that I'm nothing more than a subject for her research…
"My acting… was perfect, was it not? You were really into it all, weren't you, Haruki?"
"Hahaha… ahahaha… ahahahah… aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
There was a loud noise. And I've done something unthinkable.
I slammed Chiaki, who had been kneeling in front of me and examining my expression, onto the floor of the stage with all my strength.
"Ah, ahh… uu-ahhh…"
I'm on top of Chiaki, sealing her movement and her mouth.
This is not something a man should be doing. But my body and my heart acted beyond my control.
"Are you planning on violating me here out of revenge? …I'm a little sweaty, though, so you might have to bear with it for now, okay?"
Even though her head and back were slammed onto the floor… Chiaki's expression remained calm, she easily accepted the fact that she's being pinned down.
"Uu, kuu, ahh…"
Even though I've pinned her down in my anger, Chiaki remains unafraid, and instead looks me right in the eye with her usual, faint smile on her face.
"But I'd like to ask a favor…"
She may look like Izumi Chiaki, but this person is definitely not Izumi Chiaki.
"I saw this in an older film… there's a line that reads 'please don't hit my face because I'm an actress.'"
While on stage, she'll be unperturbed no matter what accident occurs.
"That film didn't exactly leave a deep impression on me, but somehow I sympathized with what that actress said."
Whether it be feeling pain, having trouble breathing, or having a concussion… she blocks off everything from reality and just focuses on her acting.
"So… what I'm trying to say is…"
"I know there's not much I can do if I end up not being able to give birth, but at least make sure not to hurt my face, okay?"
"Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!"
This demon of an actor… Senouchi Akira.
"Ah, ah, ah… uu, uaa… Chiaki, uaa…"
"Aa-ah, that's why I said it's better for you not to know."
But for someone like me who's not an actor nor part of the Troupe, all of this might just be "something silly."
"Ah, ahh… ua… ah…"
My tears fell onto Chiaki's face.
"Your crying face… no matter how many times I see it, it's just adorable. I want to use my body to soothe you from the bottom of my heart."
Even though I know that those are my tears, I don't want to admit it.
"Why…? Why… would you do this to me…?"
"Yeah, I really love you, Haruki. So please don't cry anymore… No, please allow me to see you cry a little longer."
"Ua… ahhh… Chiaki, you, you…!"
"Ahh… I'm loving this. Your accursed words made my feelings toward you even clearer."
"Don't… mess with me! Just how long do you intend to keep toying with me…!?"
"No, I'm serious. I really do love you, Haruki. There's no one else who loves you as much as I do in this world, you know?"
"Ah… ahh… ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Uwaa… ahhhhhhhhhhh～!"
"Your tears are delicious… Mm, nn… chuu, ahhhn…"
Everything fell apart.
Right now, the one person I've been clinging onto after abandoning everything is embracing me and planting a rain of kisses on my face.
But this is all merely an act…
An utterly enthusiastic performance from a monster of an actress who's more serious than anyone else when she's on stage but forgets everything and anything the moment she leaves it.
